svg.title: Snapshots that share pages
svg.desc: A grid of snapshots of lesson 09's recording, one row per snapshot, labelled by its tick, and one column per page of 4,096 bytes, pages 0 to 31. A filled cell is a page the snapshot copied; a pale cell is the page object of an earlier snapshot, shared. Snapshot 0 copies all 32 pages. The snapshot at tick 1,000 copies page 16. The snapshot at tick 22,000 copies pages 16, 17. The snapshot at tick 23,000 copies page 17. The snapshot at tick 45,000 copies pages 17, 18. The snapshot at tick 46,000 copies page 18. The snapshot at tick 68,000 copies pages 18, 19. The snapshot at tick 69,000 copies page 19. The snapshot at tick 70,000 copies pages 16, 17, 19. The snapshot at tick 75,000 copies pages 15, 16, 17. The snapshot at tick 652,000 copies pages 15, 16, 17. From tick 75,000 on, every snapshot copies pages 15, 16, 17 and shares the rest. The last snapshot shares 27 pages with snapshot 0.
svg.text: Each snapshot's 32 pages, and which copy each is
lesson 09's recording, a snapshot every 1,000 instructions
The last snapshot shares 27 pages with snapshot 0.
